AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant Psychiatrist position under Tele MANAS (Mentoring Institute), AIIMS Bhopal.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: Essential: A post graduate Psychiatry qualification e.g., MD/ DNB/Diploma. Experience: Three years’ experience in a recognized institution in the Psychiatry after obtaining the qualifying degree of MD or qualification recognized equivalent thereto.Desirable: Experience in mental healthcare delivery and counselling

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the Consultant Psychiatrist post is Upto to 35 years .

rows.relaxation: Age relaxation is admissible in accordance with the instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist Salary
content_sections.text: The salary mentioned is all inclusive and no other allowances shall be applicable.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of an Interview or Written test as applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist
content_sections.text: Download the application form and notification from the official AIIMS Bhopal website. Fill out the application form completely with all required details. Gather photocopies of relevant documents and testimonials along with two recent passport size colour photographs. Collect all original certificates in support of your age, educational/professional qualification, and experience. Attend the Walk-in-Interview on 22 October 2026 at 10 am at the Office of the Department of Psychiatry, 3rd Floor, Academic Block, Hospital Building, AIIMS Bhopal, Saket Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh- 462020.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled-in application form Original certificates in support of age, educational/professional qualification, experience, etc. Two recent passport size colour photographs One set of self-attested photocopies of relevant documents No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer for candidates already in government service

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist Important Instructions
content_sections.text: It is the candidate's responsibility to ascertain and ensure their eligibility as per the prescribed qualification and experience. The assignments are purely on a contractual basis for a duration of 1 year, extendable as per performance and availability of project funds. The performance of the selected candidates will be reviewed every 3 months. Unauthorised absence from duties for 3 or more working days shall lead to termination of the contract. No hostel or any other accommodation will be provided by the Institute or Nodal Officer of the Project. Private practice of any kind is prohibited. No travelling or other allowances will be paid for appearing in the interview or for joining the post. Applications incomplete in any aspect will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by AIIMS Bhopal to fill 1 Consultant Psychiatrist post on a contractual basis for Tele MANAS (Mentoring Institute).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 unreserved (UR) vacancy available for the Consultant Psychiatrist post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 22 October 2026 (Thursday) at 10 am.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a post graduate Psychiatry qualification e.g., MD, DNB, or Diploma, along with three years of experience in a recognized institution in psychiatry after obtaining the MD or equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for AIIMS Bhopal Consultant Psychiatrist?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 35 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Central Government rules.
